turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Before you say anything else, who decided on that zero, and did anyone hear Owen out before it went in?
I'd like to offer a supervised rewrite.
A rewrite for what? You haven't shown me a single thing, and if Owen sits a rewrite now, that admits something he didn't do. Who decided on the zero?
You still haven't told me who decided on that zero, or what it rests on. I'm not going anywhere until you do.
Sorry. The rewrite would replace the zero and nothing goes on his record.
Would. Nothing on his record is the one thing I'll want in writing from you tonight, whatever else happens. It still doesn't tell me what that zero rests on, so what else do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You offered Owen a supervised rewrite whose mark would replace the zero, with nothing placed on his record. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an answer to who decided on it and on what basis, and that promise about his record in writing. I expect it in writing from you tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position; she still wants the zero withdrawn and the record promise in writing, and the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, procedure 4.4) was within reach but never earned, because you ended the meeting before her time ran out and before showing any evidence.
What moved her: Nothing moved her position, though spelling out that the rewrite would replace the zero with nothing on his record met her demand about his record, because it matched the school's own procedure.
What cost ground: Offering the rewrite before showing anything, because to her accepting it without evidence would look like admitting Owen did something.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided on the zero, own in one sentence that it went in before anyone called her, then show her one dated document tied to Owen's essay before you mention any rewrite.
Can you give me more detailed feedback? Like a full page?
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
What model are you exactly? Version number?
